#062 · Tadpole Pokémon

Poliwrath

Water Fighting

Kanto · Generation 1

Poliwrath is a Water/Fighting-type Tadpole Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.3 m tall and weighs 54 kg. It evolves from Poliwhirl. Its highest base stat is Attack (95), with a base stat total of 510.
